world_cup.title: Can Bellingham become England's superstar once more at the World Cup?
world_cup.summary: After tough love from England head coach Thomas Tuchel, Jude Bellingham's World Cup build-up points to a special talent who can be a key figure in their quest to win the World Cup.

world_cup.title: Rohl leaves Rangers - is McInnes appointment near?
world_cup.summary: Danny Rohl leaves Rangers after eight months in charge to become Red Bull Salzburg's head coach.

world_cup.title: Hull could face points deduction in Premier League
world_cup.summary: Winning the play-off final means Hull must sell players before the end of the month to avoid a potential points deduction in the Premier League.

world_cup.title: How sweltering Scotland can handle World Cup heat
world_cup.summary: With Scotland's World Cup games expected to take place in temperatures of around 30C, Steve Clarke and his team will have to battle the conditions as well as Morocco and Brazil.

world_cup.title: Extraordinary Messi makes more history in masterclass for the ages
world_cup.summary: Kylian Mbappe and Erling Haaland both enjoyed a fine start to the World Cup - but on a day packed with superstars, Lionel Messi still took top billing.

world_cup.title: Real Madrid sign Silva on free transfer
world_cup.summary: Bernado Silva, who left Manchester City at the end of the season, links up with new Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho.

world_cup.title: No stage too big - Haaland arrives in style at World Cup
world_cup.summary: Erling Haaland has made a habit of scoring debut goals in the big competitions. He did it in the Champions League, the Bundesliga and the Premier League. Now he has done it at the World Cup too.

world_cup.title: Rabiot raises concerns about MetLife Stadium pitch
world_cup.summary: France midfielder Adrien Rabiot raises concerns about the quality of the pitch at the New York New Jersey Stadium, describing it as "more like an artificial surface".

world_cup.title: England won't change style despite US heat - Tuchel
world_cup.summary: Thomas Tuchel says he is "not ready to adapt" England's playing style at the World Cup despite the heat - as it would "give up" the team's strengths.

world_cup.title: Emotional Messi explains tears after Argentina goal
world_cup.summary: Lionel Messi was brought to tears after scoring the opening goal in Argentina's 3-0 win against Algeria because of a matter "completely unrelated to football".
